title: Smoking Recovery
description: Quit smoking plan with nicotine withdrawal management, habit replacement, and relapse prevention

goals.title: Break Smoking Habits
goals.description: Replace smoking triggers with healthy alternatives

habits.title: Morning Commitment
habits.description: Recommit to being smoke-free each morning

habits.title: Deep Breathing
habits.description: Practice deep breathing when urge hits

habits.title: Healthy Replacement
habits.description: Use gum, mints, or water instead of smoking

tasks.title: Set Quit Date
tasks.description: Choose and prepare for quit date

tasks.title: Remove Smoking Paraphernalia
tasks.description: Get rid of cigarettes, lighters, ashtrays

tasks.title: Identify Triggers
tasks.description: List situations that make you want to smoke

tasks.title: Prepare Replacement Activities
tasks.description: Plan what to do instead of smoking

warnings: Nicotine withdrawal is challenging but temporary
Each smoke-free day makes the next easier
Consider nicotine replacement therapy if needed
fallback_message: I found a smoking recovery template! This plan will help you quit smoking and improve your health.
